rarity_system.render_rule: Render the rarity text followed by a small diamond icon. Format: 'RARE ◆'. All rarities use diamond shape, only fill color varies. No brackets.

cost_indicator.render_rule: For RARE and GLORIOUS cards only, display the activation cost below the rarity diamond using a plus symbol and card icons.

stat_pips.filled_style: solid navy fill with gold outline

content.ART_PROMPT: A stone well shaft seen from directly above, a wet rope dropping away into darkness and a small coin of light on the water far below, no people, luminous cinematic oil painting with impressionistic brushwork, saturated full colour, a strong symbolic subject, no engraving or line art, underwater green-gold light filtering down through murky depth
content.ABILITY_TEXT: Look at the bottom three cards of the Tower. Add up to two of those cards that each have LORE four or more to your hand and put the other cards into Sheol.
content.OT_VERSE_SNIPPET: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out
content.NT_VERSE_SNIPPET: the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
content.OT_VERSE_LINE: Proverbs 20:5 — “Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out”
content.NT_VERSE_LINE: John 4:11 — “the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?”
TRIVIA_BULLETS: Hebrew keeps two depths apart: amoq for a well or a thought, tehom for the deep that covered the earth.
Jacob's well at Sychar, the one the woman calls deep, is still over thirty metres to the water.
Luke calls the dawn of the resurrection deep morning, using the same adjective as the well.

model_prompt: Generate a premium vertical trading card. Output ONLY the card; no surrounding text or watermarks. NEVER use brackets [ ]. RARITY: Print rarity text then a diamond icon (e.g. 'RARE ◆'). Diamond color: white=COMMON, green=UNCOMMON, gold=RARE, orange=GLORIOUS. All use same diamond shape. COST INDICATOR: Below rarity for RARE show '+🂠' (plus and one card), for GLORIOUS show '+🂠🂠' (plus and two cards). No cost indicator for COMMON/UNCOMMON. STAT PIPS: Use navy circles only, not diamonds. Every filled pip is one flat, solid, uniformly dark navy disc with no highlight, gloss, gradient, inner ring, or concentric texture; every empty pip is a thin navy outline with plain parchment interior. Render: header, stats, ability, OT verse, NT verse, Greek/Heb strip, trivia. Greek/Hebrew must be legible (Hebrew right-to-left).
